Auth.tagline: A little help to care better.
Auth.loginDescription: Keep track of the moments that matter.
Auth.registerDescription: Start with the basics. You can adjust everything later.
Auth.genericError: Something went wrong. Please try again.

Profile.title: You're all set
Profile.description: Your account is connected and ready.
Profile.sessionInvalid: Your session has expired. Please sign in again.

Onboarding.dateHint: Choose the first day of the period. You can update it later.
Onboarding.privacy: Your information stays private and is only used to create cycle reminders.
Onboarding.genericError: We couldn't load your setup. Please try again.
Onboarding.welcomeTitle: Be there at the right time
Onboarding.welcomeDescription: bebo helps you keep track of your partner's cycle and reminds you before the next period may begin.
Onboarding.welcomeBenefitCycleHint: See the next estimated period date without having to remember it yourself.
Onboarding.welcomeBenefitReminderHint: Receive daily reminders through Telegram, Discord, or both.
Onboarding.welcomeBenefitCareHint: A small reminder can help you be more thoughtful and supportive.
Onboarding.cycleDescription: Add the first day of the most recent period. bebo will use this to estimate the next cycle.
Onboarding.defaultCycleLengthHint: Not sure? Keep 28 days. bebo will learn from new cycle records over time.
Onboarding.cycleSaveError: We couldn't save the cycle information.
Onboarding.reminderDescription: Set how early and what time bebo should send your daily private reminder.
Onboarding.timezoneHint: This controls the local time when your reminder is sent.
Onboarding.previewMessage: {count, plural, =0 {Daily reminders will begin on the estimated period date.} one {Daily reminders will begin one day before the estimated period.} other {Daily reminders will begin # days before the estimated period.}}
Onboarding.reminderSaveError: We couldn't save the reminder settings.
Onboarding.channelsDescription: Connect Telegram, Discord, or both. Each connected channel will receive its own private daily reminder.
Onboarding.channelsChoiceHint: You can connect one channel or both channels. You can change this later in Settings.
Onboarding.channelsPrivacy: Messages are only sent to your connected accounts. Your partner will not receive them.
Onboarding.skipChannelsHint: You can continue without connecting a channel, but bebo cannot send reminders until one is connected.
Onboarding.completeDescription: bebo is ready to help you remember the moments when a little extra care may matter.

Dashboard.description: A simple view of your partner's next estimated cycle.
Dashboard.daysUntil: {count, plural, =0 {Expected today} one {# day remaining} other {# days remaining}}
Dashboard.daysPast: {count, plural, one {Estimate passed # day ago} other {Estimate passed # days ago}}
Dashboard.basedOnHistory: {count, plural, one {Based on # recent cycle} other {Based on # recent cycles}}
Dashboard.addPeriodDescription: Choose the first day of the period.
Dashboard.loadError: We couldn't load your cycle data.
Dashboard.editPeriodDescription: Update the first day of this period.
Dashboard.deleteConfirmDescription: This date will be removed and your cycle prediction will be recalculated. This action cannot be undone.
Dashboard.reminderStatusUnavailableDescription: bebo couldn't check your notification channels right now.
Dashboard.channelsPendingDescription: Complete the Telegram or Discord connection to start receiving reminders.
Dashboard.remindersOffDescription: Connect Telegram, Discord, or both so bebo can send private daily reminders.
Dashboard.deliveryFailed: A reminder could not be delivered
Dashboard.channelDeliveryStopped: The latest reminder could not be delivered through {channel}.
Dashboard.dailyRemindersOneChannel: bebo will send private daily reminders through {channel}.
Dashboard.dailyRemindersBothChannels: bebo will send private daily reminders through Telegram and Discord.
Dashboard.connectedChannels: {count, plural, one {# channel connected} other {# channels connected}}
Dashboard.dailyReminderContinues: After this date, bebo sends one reminder per day until a new period is logged or the reminder window ends.
Dashboard.channelStatusUnavailableDescription: The connection status could not be loaded.
Dashboard.channelPendingDescription: Finish connecting this channel to activate reminders.
Dashboard.channelAlreadyLinkedDescription: This account is connected to another bebo account.
Dashboard.channelLatestRetryAt: The latest reminder will be retried at {time}.
Dashboard.channelLatestFailed: The latest reminder could not be delivered.
Dashboard.channelConnected: Connected and ready for the next reminder.

Notifications.title: Notification history
Notifications.description: Review cycle reminders sent privately through Telegram or Discord.
Notifications.emptyDescription: Sent and failed cycle reminders will appear here after the first scheduled reminder.

Settings.title: Settings
Settings.description: Adjust how cycle predictions and reminders work.
Settings.defaultCycleLengthHint: Used until enough cycle history is available.
Settings.reminderDaysHint: Choose how many days before the expected period.
Settings.timezoneHint: Use an IANA time zone such as Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh.
Settings.changesHint: Changes apply to the next prediction and reminder.
Settings.notificationHistoryHint: View sent, failed, and retried cycle reminders.
Settings.discordConnectedNotice: Discord is now connected. Private reminders can be sent to both Telegram and Discord.
Settings.discordAlreadyLinkedNotice: This Discord account is already connected to another bebo account.
Settings.discordExpiredNotice: The Discord connection link expired. Start the connection again.
Settings.discordDeliveryFailedNotice: Discord was authorized, but bebo couldn't send the confirmation message. Check the bot configuration and try again.
Settings.discordInvalidNotice: The Discord connection request is invalid or has already been used.
